plan.prior_issue68: Old1862f4a8/guest6d744220 UPDATE355ms had an undo-page structural correspondence; short later samples bound purge/rseg/page IO owner. Long UPDATE cause remained unknown. Do not reuse old function IDs or owners.
plan.workload: same shop70/Pipe/P8,cap9,16/8MiB. NoSQL/settings intervention beyond already tested pool values.
plan.positive_control: one separate16MiB suite, actual SQL SELECT SLEEP(0.25) before Snapshot; validate caller window, db_id label and generated guest stack. No natural runs if binding control fails.
plan.usable: snapshot wholly within actual caller window, untruncated, matching database owner label and generated guest frames. Still a point sample, not total wait duration.
plan.labels: root/fork started in pprof.Do with unique per-process DB id; spawned guest threads inherit labels. Positive control validates this on current binary.
plan.exit: one positive control then4natural suites, no resampling. SAME_PATH / DIFFERENT_PATH / PARTIAL / NOT_REPRODUCED with matching evidence; no root-cause or parameter fix without evidence.
